description: Header file defining a SpinLock class for mutual exclusion with support for cooperative scheduling, profiling hooks, and thread safety annotations, used internally within the Abseil library.

classes.name: SpinLock
classes.description: A mutual exclusion lock designed for internal use, supporting cooperative scheduling and thread safety annotations.

classes.name: SpinLockHolder
classes.description: A RAII-style lock guard that acquires a SpinLock on construction and releases it on destruction.

methods.name: SpinLock()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the lock in a cooperative mode.

methods.name: explicit SpinLock(base_internal::SchedulingMode mode)
methods.description: Constructor allowing creation of a SpinLock with a specified scheduling mode.

methods.name: constexpr SpinLock(absl::ConstInitType, base_internal::SchedulingMode mode)
methods.description: Constructor for global SpinLock instances with compile-time initialization.

methods.name: ~SpinLock()
methods.description: Destructor, conditionally defined to integrate with ThreadSanitizer.

methods.name: void Lock()
methods.description: Acquires the lock, blocking if necessary.

methods.name: bool TryLock()
methods.description: Attempts to acquire the lock without blocking, returning true if successful.

methods.name: void Unlock()
methods.description: Releases the lock, must be held by the calling thread.

methods.name: bool IsHeld() const
methods.description: Checks if the lock is currently held.

methods.name: void AssertHeld() const
methods.description: Asserts that the current thread holds the lock.

methods.name: static uint32_t EncodeWaitCycles(int64_t, int64_t)
methods.description: Encodes wait cycle duration into a lock value.

methods.name: static int64_t DecodeWaitCycles(uint32_t)
methods.description: Decodes wait cycle duration from a lock value.

methods.name: uint32_t TryLockInternal(uint32_t, uint32_t)
methods.description: Internal method to attempt lock acquisition with wait cycles.

methods.name: void SlowLock()
methods.description: Handles slow path for lock acquisition.
